text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic female character. long pale blonde hair with wispy bangs, blue eyes, clear face without any moles, freckles or dark beauty marks, black blazer, white collared shirt and black-gold striped tie. One straight frontal eye-level head-and-shoulder portrait, neutral resting expression, white seamless background and even soft studio lighting. Pure white background, finely detailed natural skin, consistent identity and original hairstyle, no text or watermark.
original_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Input image is the sole identity reference. Create ONE independent studio identity portrait of exactly the same person, retaining their distinctive facial proportions, eye shape, nose, lip shape, face outline, age appearance, complexion, moles and freckles. Do not merge with any other person, idealize into a generic face, change sex presentation or age. Appearance and clothing: long pale blond hair with light wispy bangs, blue eyes, black school-style blazer over white shirt with dark striped tie; remove broad smile completely. Hair color may vary subtly but preserve recognizable style.
MOST IMPORTANT: perfectly straight frontal passport composition, head and torso square to the camera. Zero yaw, zero roll, zero pitch. Camera at pupil level exactly on facial midline. Eyes on a horizontal line. Nose bridge, nose tip, philtrum, lip center and chin on the same vertical image-center axis. Both cheeks equally exposed and both shoulders level, equal perspective on both sides. No sideways gaze; pupils directly into camera. Never tilted, turned, leaning, looking up or down. Natural anatomical asymmetry is allowed but no perspective or pose asymmetry. Full hair/crown in frame with white margin above; tight head-and-shoulders crop at upper chest, vertical 3:4 composition.
EXPRESSION: calm, emotionally neutral, relaxed resting face. Smooth relaxed brow with no frown, no raised eyebrow, no narrowed eyes or intense glare. Relaxed lower eyelids, cheeks and jaw. Lips gently touching naturally, corners level, no smile, smirk, pout, parted lips, visible teeth, flirtation or fashion-model attitude. Preserve actual lip shape while relaxing the expression.
Pure solid white #FFFFFF seamless background. Soft broad symmetrical frontal studio lighting; neutral white balance, equal illumination both cheeks, no directional shadows, flash glare, colored lights or rim lighting. Realistic fine skin texture, gentle natural finish, no excessive smoothing or oily shine. Keep individual appearance; for an originally stylized reference preserve its proportions while giving clean realistic photographic skin. Remove original scene, hands, props, watermarks, text and logos. No frame, labels, collage or document mockup. One person only.
